remarks: Drenched in natural light and boasting gorgeous hardwood floors, the inviting living room is complete with a cozy fireplace, setting the perfect stage for relaxation with a hot cup of coco. The breathtaking new kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring sleek stainless steel appliances, expansive quartz countertops, and ample storage. It seamlessly flows into a sunlit dining area, perfect for entertaining guests. The spacious master suite is your personal oasis, offering a luxurious en-suite bathroom and with generous closet space. Two additional well-appointed bedrooms and a full bathroom complete the upper level. The finished lower level provides endless possibilities, whether you envision a playroom, gym, or home office. Step outside to the beautifully landscaped backyard and unwind on the stone patio. The detached 2-car garage offering plenty of storage space. Don't miss this meticulously maintained home in the Ridges ! Enjoy easy access to restaurants, transportation, and shopping. This unassuming space hides a stunning interior that will captivate you. Once you step through the door you'll discover a hidden gem that will surely steal your heart.
